test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
Hirakud reservoir is built across the river ________.

A. Sutlej

B. Godavari

C. Mahanadi

D. Narmada
solution:
• Hirakud Dam is the longest and one of the largest reservoirs of the world.
 
• It is built on river Mahanadi, about 15 kilometres from Sambalpur in the state of Odisha in India.
 
• It is one of the first major multipurpose river valley projects started after India's independence.
 
• It was built in 1957.
